description: This file defines the CategoryDao interface, which declares methods for accessing and querying Category entities in the database, related to categories in a shop management system.

classes.name: CategoryDao
classes.description: Data access object interface for Category entities, providing methods to retrieve categories based on various criteria.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories associated with a specific store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store that have a specified parent category.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Gets categories based on a lineage string within a store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by name within a store and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by code within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a given store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a given store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its unique ID.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories within a store at a specific depth in the category hierarchy.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories within a store at a specific depth and language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories based on a lineage string, using store code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories that have the specified category as their parent, considering language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a category by category ID and associated language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns counts of products grouped by categories within a store, based on a list of category IDs.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Fetches categories by store, list of codes, and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Fetches categories by store, list of IDs, and language.
